# brig create

Create and start a VM

## Synopsis

```text
brig create NAME
```

## Description

Create a VM from the newest base image (building one first if none exists)
and start it. Settings not given as flags come from config.yaml. Before it
does any work, it runs the checks of [`brig doctor`](brig-doctor.md) that need no time and stops
if one fails.

Mounts share host directories with the VM via virtiofs:

```text
--mount SOURCE[:TARGET][:OPTIONS]
```

TARGET defaults to /mnt/\<basename of SOURCE\>. OPTIONS is a comma-separated
list of ro (default), rw and sandbox; sandbox also offers the directory to
OpenShell sandboxes, read-only, as a Podman volume named after the mount's
tag (see [`brig show`](brig-show.md) and brig sandbox create --help).

OpenShell config directories hold provider profiles and providers, which
brig applies to the VM's gateway at every start, and a default sandbox
policy, which [`brig use`](brig-use.md) NAME exports (see [`brig sync`](brig-sync.md) --help).
Without --openshell-config, the VM gets the directories listed as
openshell.configs in config.yaml.

With --wait, the command fails unless the new VM's gateway answers and its
config directories sync, as [`brig start`](brig-start.md) --wait does.

## Examples

```sh
brig create dev
brig create dev --memory 16GiB --mount ~/src/project:/work/project:rw
brig create offline --profile isolated
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--cpus int` | number of virtual CPUs |
| `--data-disk size` | size of the persistent data disk holding /home/agent, e.g. 40GiB |
| `--image string` | base image ID (default: newest) |
| `--memory size` | memory size, e.g. 8GiB |
| `--mount stringArray` | share a host directory: SOURCE[:TARGET][:OPTIONS], OPTIONS a comma-separated list of ro (default), rw and sandbox (repeatable) |
| `--no-openshell-config` | apply no OpenShell config directories |
| `--no-start` | create the VM without starting it |
| `--openshell-config stringArray` | OpenShell config directory to apply to the VM's gateway (repeatable; default: openshell.configs from config.yaml) |
| `-o, --output format` | output format: table or json (default `table`) |
| `--profile string` | network profile (see config.yaml) |
| `--root-disk size` | root disk size, e.g. 20GiB |
| `--wait` | fail unless the gateway answers and the OpenShell config directories sync |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
